description: When a task cannot be completed with the current tools or methods after a genuine attempt, research additional tools/plugins/extensions/resources/methods, install and verify them when approved, then extend Gypsy with the reusable capability/toolpack/slice.
requires: network access for web research (or an offline reference set when unavailable)
operator approval for installs or elevated operations
notes: This capability is the Gypsy extension for the operator's research-escalation rule; it does not modify GYPSY_HOME.
